question: Inlet Pipes A and B can together fill an empty tank in 1.5 hours. Outlet Pipe C, when opened alone, can empty the completely filled tank, in 4.5 hours. When only Pipes A and C are opened together, the empty tank is filled in 6 hours. Find the time taken by Pipe B, when opened alone, to fill the empty tank.
solution:
**Calculation:**

Total work or capacity of the tank is = LCM of (1.5, 4.5, 6) = 18 unit

Efficiency of (A + B) = 18/1.5 = 12 unit

Efficiency of C = 18/4.5 = - 4 unit

Efficiency of (A - C) = 18/6 = 3
